title: Easier Fish Farming
description: This mod gives you a toggleable keybind so itll throw out the rod when you reel it in, this is mainly made for servers so auto fish farms will work continuiously just look at the noteblocks, hold right click and toggle the mod
body: better fishing mod for autofishing WITH FARMS, its NOT an autofishing mod its designed to be used with farms containing a noteblock, you hold down right click like normal with the farm and just turn on the toggle so it throws the fishing rod out automatically if it doesnt when its supposed to, reccommended for use on servers, idk about public ones and if you complain about getting banned ill ignore it
